answer.policy_title: Cohere Medical Policy - Shoulder Arthroscopy (Version 5), Avera Health Plans
criteria_quotes: Advanced imaging with radiologist report that demonstrates ANY of the following:
High-grade partial-thickness rotator cuff tear; AND
Documentation must include a recent and detailed history, physical examination related to the onset or change in symptoms, relevant lab results, prior imaging, and details of previous treatments.
Significant pain or functional impairment that impacts activities of daily living (ADLs); AND
Documentation of an acute rotator cuff tear (RCT) after an inciting event or injury; OR
Documentation of a chronic RCT and ALL of the following22:
Failure of conservative managementA, including ALL of the following:

Anti-inflammatory medications, non-opioid analgesics, neuropathic medications, or other pain
medications, if not contraindicated; AND

Physical therapy (PT) and/or documentation of patient compliance with a home exercise
prescription/plan (HEP) provided by a physician or physical therapist targeting the
requested region; AND
PT/HEP trialed for a duration of 3 months or more; OR
Progression or worsening of symptoms due to PT/HEP; AND
Corticosteroid injection if medically appropriate10; OR
Documentation that corticosteroid injection is contraindicated; OR

The patient has completed a full course of conservative management without meaningful improvement.
Patient noncompliance, closure of therapy offices, and patient inconvenience do not constitute a failure of
conservative treatment.
answer.submission_route: Use the appeal address printed on your denial letter, or call the number on the back of your insurance card and ask where member appeals are filed.
